mcp.intro: MCP ni uburyo busanzwe butuma abakozi ba AI (Claude, Cursor, porogaramu zanyu) bakorana na serivisi zo hanze. Umukozi wa AI ufite tokeni ashobora gushakisha no gusoma ubutumwa bwanyu n'imigereka (iyagenzuwe na antivirusi gusa), kureba abo muvugana na kalendari, no gutegura imishinga. Ashobora guhindura no kohereza ubutumwa gusa niba mubimwemereye. Ibyo umukozi wa AI akora byose byandikwa mu gitabo.

srv.hintGmail: {0} — Gmail ntiyemera ijambobanga risanzwe rya konti: hakenewe “ijambobanga rya porogaramu”. Mufungure Kugenzura mu ntambwe 2 kuri konti ya Google maze mukore ijambobanga kuri myaccount.google.com/apppasswords (inyuguti 16); izina ryo kwinjira ni aderesi yuzuye ya @gmail.com.
srv.hintMailru: {0} — Mail.ru ntiyemera ijambobanga risanzwe: mukore “ijambobanga rya porogaramu yo hanze” (Igenamiterere → Umutekano → Amagambobanga ya porogaramu zo hanze).
srv.hintOutlook: {0} — Outlook/Microsoft akenshi ihagarika kwinjira hakoreshejwe ijambobanga kuri porogaramu z'iposita: mugenzure ko IMAP/SMTP byemewe mu igenamiterere ry'agasanduku, cyangwa mukoreshe ijambobanga rya porogaramu.
srv.hintRateLimited: {0} — seriveri y'inkomoko yagabanyije by'agateganyo ikurwamo ry'ubutumwa (Gmail yemera hafi GB 2.5 ku munsi kuri porogaramu z'iposita). Umukusanyi azakomeza ubwe umupaka nukurwaho, akenshi mu munsi umwe.
srv.hintYandex: {0} — Yandex ntiyemera ijambobanga risanzwe: mukore “ijambobanga rya porogaramu” (id.yandex.ru → Umutekano → Amagambobanga ya porogaramu → Iposita) kandi mufungure uburyo bwa IMAP munsi ya “Porogaramu z'iposita” mu igenamiterere ry'iposita.
